title: OCI Programmatic Credential Creation Burst
description: Correlates OCI Audit events for uploaded API keys, auth tokens, and customer secret keys. Multiple credential types or repeated creations by the same principal and source IP in one hunt window warrant review because they expand programmatic access paths.
query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI Audit Logs' and ('Event Type' = 'com.oraclecloud.identitycontrolplane.uploadapikey' or 'Event Type' = 'com.oraclecloud.identitycontrolplane.createauthtoken' or 'Event Type' = 'com.oraclecloud.identitycontrolplane.createcustomersecretkey') | stats count as CredentialChanges, distinctcount('Event Type') as CredentialTypes, earliest(Time) as FirstSeen, latest(Time) as LastSeen by 'User Name', 'Source IP' | where CredentialChanges > 1 or CredentialTypes > 1 | sort -CredentialChanges
falsepositives: Planned service-account onboarding or migration activity
Automation that rotates multiple credential types together
investigation_notes: Confirm the principal, source IP, and change ticket for each credential creation event.
Review new credential scope and downstream Object Storage or API activity before revocation.
Pivot by User Name and Source IP over the same time window for IAM policy or group changes.
